flora: Early_Angiosperms (small, primitive flowering clusters clustered tightly near a rare wash)
Conifers (as background verticality, hardy and drought-resistant)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; soft, stylized petals with tactile, waxy textures; rounded forms avoiding sharp edges; vibrant but natural color accents that stand out against the sun-baked, arid terrain.

visual_logic.composition: A close-up 'hero' shot of primitive flowering plants emerging resiliently beside a sun-baked petrified log. The background is a soft-focus vista of a vast, dusty semi-arid floodplain horizon.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, sun-cracked dusty red mudflats with cross-bedded tan sandstone channels and scattered purple claystone fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; intense, direct midday sun casting harsh cinematic shadows across the cracked earth, with a hot atmospheric glow highlighting the delicate translucency of the petals.
